fusions.name: Miles in the Legs
fusions.desc: Spits a clot of pond water that hits the first enemy in its path for 12 damage and knocks it back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Churned Track
fusions.desc: Kicks up a strip of mud 5 tiles long ahead of you that lasts 6 seconds. It deals 6 damage to each enemy that crosses it and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Long Haul
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 20% for 20 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Rest Between Hops
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you restore 5 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
